entries.name: Anime.js
entries.use_for: Animate CSS, SVG, DOM attributes and JS objects with timelines.
entries.why: Lightweight, popular engine with a clean API and scroll/timeline features in v4.

entries.name: AutoAnimate
entries.use_for: Add smooth transitions when elements are added, removed or moved, with one line.
entries.why: Zero-config drop-in for lists and layout changes; works with React, Vue, Svelte and vanilla.

entries.name: Lenis
entries.use_for: Smooth scrolling that works with scroll-driven animations.
entries.why: Lightweight and widely used on design-heavy sites; integrates with GSAP and Motion.

entries.name: Lottie React Native
entries.use_for: Play Lottie animations in React Native apps
entries.why: Standard Lottie player for React Native

entries.name: Lottie Web
entries.use_for: Play After Effects animations exported as Lottie JSON on the web
entries.why: The original Lottie player; still the most installed
entries.stable_reason: Mature After Effects/Bodymovin JSON player; format and API are settled and widely deployed

entries.name: mo.js
entries.use_for: Create motion graphics and micro-interactions for the web.
entries.why: Declarative toolkit for bursts, shapes and tweened effects.

entries.name: Motion
entries.use_for: Animate React, Vue and vanilla JS with springs, gestures, layout and scroll animations.
entries.why: Formerly Framer Motion; the default animation library for React with a small vanilla core.

entries.name: NumberFlow
entries.use_for: Animated number transitions for React, Vue and Svelte

entries.name: React Native Reanimated
entries.use_for: Run smooth animations on the UI thread in React Native.
entries.why: The standard animation library for React Native, maintained by Software Mansion.

entries.name: react-spring
entries.use_for: Spring-physics animations for React, React Native and three.js
entries.why: Popular physics-based animation library from pmndrs

entries.name: Rive (web)
entries.use_for: Run interactive Rive state-machine animations on the web

entries.name: scroll-craft
entries.use_for: Agent skill for building premium, scroll-driven websites with layered heroes, motion and a real design standard.
entries.why: Unusually high design bar with ten worked example sites; includes its own scroll engine and verification tools.

exception.reason: Maintainer pick: exceptional design quality and worked examples despite a single maintainer.

entries.name: Shifty
entries.use_for: Low-level, fast tweening engine for TypeScript/JavaScript.
entries.why: Small, dependency-free core to build custom animation tooling on.

entries.name: SVG.js
entries.why: Lightweight, readable API for SVG drawing and animation.

entries.name: swup
entries.use_for: Add animated page transitions to server-rendered websites.
entries.why: Plugin-based and framework-free; good for static or CMS-driven sites.

entries.name: tween.js
entries.use_for: Tween numeric properties of JS objects with easing.
entries.why: Tiny, long-standing tween engine, commonly paired with three.js.

entries.name: Typed.js
entries.use_for: Typewriter-style text animation for hero sections and landing pages
entries.why: The classic typing-effect library (15k+ stars); small, dependency-free and feature-complete
entries.stable_reason: Feature-complete, dependency-free typewriter effect; small API that needs no ongoing changes
